<b>Cogwork Choirbugs</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are finely forged [[Cogwork Bugs|automatons]] who work tirelessly to maintain the [[Cogwork Core]].<ref>Cogwork Choirbug [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Bug forged of iron, rotor and cog. The automaton works tirelessly to maintain the Core that houses it. Its core is filled with fine mechanisms, but that alone should not produce such a convincing mimic of life."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Cogwork Choirbugs walk back and forth on a platform, pausing frequently. If one spots [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], it extends its sharp claws and begins to walk forwards whilst slashing in front of itself wildly, not stopping until it reaches an edge or Hornet gets behind it. This attack comboes Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} if she gets hit by the slashes. If a Cogwork Choirbug bumps into another enemy during the attack, both are knocked back slightly and stunned for a brief moment.

Cogwork Choirbugs can be easily defeated by luring them to the edge of a platform and then pushing them off into cogs.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Cogwork Choirbugs have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

* ...To mend...

== Location ==
Cogwork Choirbugs can be found throughout the [[Cogwork Core]], and three of them are fought as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Cogwork Core 1|enemy gauntlet]] in the southwest of the area. After the fight, up to two of them can spawn upon each return to the arena.

== Trivia ==
* Cogwork Choirbugs share their Needolin dialogue with [[Cogwork Cleanser]]s, [[Cogwork Defender]]s, [[Cogwork Clapper]]s, [[Cogworker]]s, [[Cogwork Spine]]s, [[Cogwork Crawler|Cogwork Crawler]]s, and [[Cogwork Underfly|Cogwork Underflies]].
** They also share their singing audio with Cogwork Cleansers.
